name: Moody Tongue
dinnerNoteZh: 品嚐套餐，10道菜以上（啤酒搭配 $75、$115 或 $145）

menus.name: Dining Room tasting menu
menus.note: Ten or more courses with Moody Tongue's own beers: Classic beer pairing $75, Reserve $115, Grand Reserve $145 (a pairing can be shared for $25). Tax (10.75%) and a 22% service charge, which includes the tip, are added.

alsoTry.name: The Bar at Moody Tongue
alsoTry.note: The brewery's bar in the same building, with an à la carte dinner menu by the same chef (starters about $15–$22, mains $29–$85); booking recommended but not required.

bookingOpens: Online on SevenRooms. Tables open 42 days ahead, a day at a time, at midnight Chicago time, and must be booked at least 24 hours ahead (for shorter notice, email contact@moodytongue.com). Seatings are at 6:30pm on Wednesdays and Thursdays and at 6pm and 8:30pm on Fridays and Saturdays.
cancellation: Cancellations and changes to party size must be made at least a week ahead; within a week there are no refunds.
waitlist: For the Dining Room, email your name, phone number and preferred dates to contact@moodytongue.com.
groups: Large parties (11 or more on Wednesdays and Thursdays, five or more on Fridays and Saturdays) book by email at contact@moodytongue.com. The Dining Room can be hired privately for up to 28 seated, with six- or 15-course tasting menus, and the brewery has larger rooms.
dressCode: No dress code, though most Dining Room guests dress up a little ("date ready"). Guests are asked not to wear strong perfume or cologne.
duration: About two to two and a half hours.
